name: @vssaros/dsh-workitem
description: VsSaros work-item kernel for DeepSeek Harness: the shared, stateless judgement layer behind unattended loops and agent group chat — ledger state machine (dedupe / backoff / attempts / crash recovery), per-round picking with exclusion reasons, completion contract [item:...], #task tag parsing, ring-storm budget, and the system-message gate. Consumers bind it via the cordis service `vssarosWorkItems`; it owns no storage and registers no tools.
